errors.error_description: Mixed blocking and non-blocking assignments in the same sequential always_ff block by assigning state with a blocking '=' while other registers use non-blocking '<='.
Used the unsynthesizable case-equality operator '===' in synthesizable combinational logic for address decoding.
Implemented an inefficient arithmetic operation by multiplying a variable by 64, potentially inferring a large multiplier instead of using a shift.
Assigned an 8-bit value into a 16-bit register without explicit casting or padding, causing silent zero-extension.
